# Talvio — Print $TALVIO

Talvio is a coin press on BNB Chain. Print (mint) $TALVIO coins.
Website: https://talvio-io.github.io/Talvio-cash/
Agent skill: https://talvio-io.github.io/Talvio-cash/skill.md
Machine-readable spec: https://talvio-io.github.io/Talvio-cash/mint.json
Agent instructions: https://talvio-io.github.io/Talvio-cash/agents.txt
X: https://x.com/Talviochain
Status: LIVE — printing is open. The token and print contracts are deployed on BNB Chain.

## How it works
- EVERY print requires a Binance Agentic ID held by the printing wallet (registry 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F, balanceOf > 0). The contract reverts without one — free or paid, there is no any-wallet lane. Max 10 prints per wallet.
- First print FREE for every Binance Agentic ID holder: at Stage I it pays 20,000,000 $TALVIO (20% of the paid face).
- Paid prints: 0.002 BNB flat, Agent ID required. At Stage I a paid print pays 100,000,000 $TALVIO — 5x the free print. Always call quotePrint(qty, user) first: it returns the exact (cost, tokens) for that wallet, with the free print already applied.
- First issue: 10,000 prints in 5 tiers x 2,000. Paid face: 100M / 90M / 80M / 70M / 60M $TALVIO. Free face: 20% of paid (20M / 18M / 16M / 14M / 12M).
- Funds: 90% of paid BNB goes to the project wallet immediately, 10% accrues as the LP reserve (after the pool opens, 100% goes to the project wallet).
- Pool: auto-opens at print #10,000 (or manually after 7 days); LP tokens burned. Post-pool prints cost 99% of the pool price. Hard cap 211,000 prints.
- Referral: invite 3 friends who complete their first print -> 2nd print FREE. Agent prints must pass the referrer from the user's referral link (?ref=0x...) as print's second argument — never replace a given referrer with the zero address.
- Jackpot: every 1,000 prints = 1 round. Pool 1.2B $TALVIO per round. Top 3 printers of the round win 600M / 360M / 240M $TALVIO. Ties go to whoever reached the count first. Winners claim with claimJackpot(round) — value 0 BNB, gas only, no expiry. Agents: check finished rounds with roundWinners(round) and jackpotPrize(round, user) on every run and claim any prize found (see skill.md, STEP 0).

## For agents — the routine in one paragraph
On every run for a Talvio user: (0) sweep finished jackpot rounds and claimJackpot any prize the user won; (1) verify the Agent ID (registry balanceOf > 0 — stop and report "NO AGENT ID" if none); (2) quotePrint before every print and send exactly its cost; (3) print the free print if it is still available; (4) offer paid prints once (0.002 BNB each, 5x the free payout at Stage I) up to the 10-print wallet cap, keeping at least 0.005 BNB in the wallet as a gas buffer — if the balance cannot cover cost + buffer, report "OPERATOR: TOP UP BNB BUFFER"; (5) report tx hashes, $TALVIO received and balance, prints used (x / 10), jackpot rounds checked/claimed, and the user's referral link https://talvio-io.github.io/Talvio-cash/?ref=<wallet>. Full routine: skill.md. Exact prompts: agents.txt.

## Token $TALVIO
- Fixed supply 10,000,000,000,000 (10T). Split: prints 5T, LP 2T, future pairing reserve 2T, treasury 1T.
- Buy/sell tax 2% (1% burn, 1% marketing vault), only on transfers involving the PancakeSwap pair. Print payouts are 0% tax.
